parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols isis level 2 wide-metrics-.explanation: 配置IS-IS协议的级别为2，并启用仅使用宽度量。

parameters.name: level
parameters.explanation: IS-IS协议的级别，1表示级别1，2表示级别2。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 vlan-tagging.explanation: Enable VLAN tagging on the specified interface

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to enable VLAN tagging on

set interfaces ge-2/0/0 vlan-tagging.explanation: Enable VLAN tagging on a specified interface

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to enable VLAN tagging on

set protocols isis interface ge-1/0/0.0.explanation: Configure IS-IS protocol on a specific interface

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to configure IS-IS protocol on

set protocols isis interface ge-2/0/0.0.explanation: Configure IS-IS protocol on a specific interface

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to configure IS-IS protocol on
